title: Instruction for an arithmetic operation
statement: An arithmetic operation is translated to the WordRAM instruction with the same operation: addition to addition, subtraction to subtraction, and multiplication to multiplication. The instruction takes the three supplied integer register addresses as its destination and two source addresses, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: The operation is addition, subtraction, or multiplication
Three integer register addresses are supplied
